text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle seems especially distracted during our training session.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh… That cloud looks just like a good cut of steak. Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: …Sorry, Trainer. With all these races lately, I'm kinda runnin' outta power…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh… How can I make anybody happy feelin' like this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running all those back-to-back races is taking its toll on her. I'd better adjust her race schedule.
